BODY - SAS AIRBAG
SRS AIRBAG
PRECAUTION
The CEUCA is equipped with an SAS (Supplemental Restraint System) such as the driver airbag, front pas­
senger airbag, slde airbag and seat belt pretensioner. Failure to carry out service operation in the correct
sequence could cause the SRS to unexpectedly deploy during servicing, possibly leading to a serious acci­
dent. Before servicing {including removal or installation of parts, inspection or replacement), be sure to read
the precautionary notices in the RS section.
